row.title: A relay result is read back per channel, never stored as posted
row.body: Relay returned linkedin/substack scheduled and facebook/instagram no-channel; publisher stored posted. Rows are now per service with status verified, queued, unverified or failed; failed services retry up to 3 times; per-service rows override a legacy relay row. Live relay qnfo-social patched to share now; its source is not in QNFO/qnfo-workers (open loop: put it there, add a cancel route for stale Buffer queue entries).
